function.name: glob_search
function.description: Search for files using glob patterns similar to Claude Code's file search functionality

pattern.description: Glob pattern to search for files (e.g., '*.py', 'src/**/*.js', 'documents/**/*.md')

root_dir.description: Root directory to start the search from (default: current directory)

recursive.description: Whether to search recursively in subdirectories (default: true)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)
